atoms.exact_source_text: Many players will not treat a Resident Guest as emotionally complete if the base game first teaches them that only expedition-capable characters are useful.
atoms.normalized_claim: Players may not view Resident Guests as emotionally complete if expedition-capability is taught as the sole measure of usefulness.

atoms.exact_source_text: The design therefore provides every Guest with an ordinary civic share and a qualitative species Signature.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every Guest is given an ordinary civic share and a qualitative species Signature by design.

atoms.exact_source_text: The strategic reason to welcome WHOOT or the Goldwings is real;
atoms.normalized_claim: The strategic reason to welcome WHOOT or the Goldwings is genuine.

atoms.exact_source_text: the later grief, affection, and memory become possible because the game never asked the player to accept a knowingly inferior option for sentiment alone.
atoms.normalized_claim: Later grief, affection, and memory become possible because the game never asked players to accept a knowingly inferior option purely for sentiment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Named Mouse, Rabbit, or Squirrel belonging to the campaign's civilization grammar.
atoms.normalized_claim: Core Citizen is defined as a Named Mouse, Rabbit, or Squirrel belonging to the campaign's civilization grammar.

atoms.exact_source_text: Default unit, generic worker, or moral standard against which Guests are lesser.
atoms.normalized_claim: Core Citizen is not a default unit, generic worker, or moral standard against which Guests are lesser.

atoms.exact_source_text: Named non-Core Citizen welcomed through relationship and accommodation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest Citizen is defined as a Named non-Core Citizen welcomed through relationship and accommodation.

atoms.exact_source_text: Pet, follower, companion slot, collectible, perk module, or temporary hireling.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest Citizen is not a pet, follower, companion slot, collectible, perk module, or temporary hireling.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guest whose species Signature is a bounded Permission inside the shared Away systems.
atoms.normalized_claim: Expedition Guest is defined as a Guest whose species Signature is a bounded Permission inside the shared Away systems.

atoms.exact_source_text: A bespoke class with its own Register, combat rules, or Exposure track.
atoms.normalized_claim: Expedition Guest is not a bespoke class with its own Register, combat rules, or Exposure track.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guest whose species Signature is a situated Affordance inside DWELL / Home MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resident Guest is defined as a Guest whose species Signature is a situated Affordance inside DWELL / Home MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: Ambient scenery, passive building bonus, or incomplete expedition character.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resident Guest is not ambient scenery, a passive building bonus, or an incomplete expedition character.

atoms.exact_source_text: The smallest living subject the Colony can meaningfully know and count.
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizen subject is defined as the smallest living subject the Colony can meaningfully know and count.

atoms.exact_source_text: Raw biological body count or Away body-unit.
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizen subject is not a raw biological body count or Away body-unit.

atoms.exact_source_text: Bounded Away option made possible by an Expedition Guest.
atoms.normalized_claim: Signature Permission is defined as a bounded Away option made possible by an Expedition Guest.

atoms.exact_source_text: Automatic solution, generic stat increase, or route bypass.
atoms.normalized_claim: Signature Permission is not an automatic solution, generic stat increase, or route bypass.

atoms.exact_source_text: Situated Home possibility made possible by a Resident Guest, their perception, or their House.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resident Affordance is defined as a situated Home possibility made possible by a Resident Guest, their perception, or their House.

atoms.exact_source_text: Permanent production multiplier or universal immunity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resident Affordance is not a permanent production multiplier or universal immunity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species-authored way a Resident Guest contributes one ordinary Role Capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest Practice is defined as a species-authored way a Resident Guest contributes one ordinary Role Capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Personal aptitude score or superior worker tier.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest Practice is not a personal aptitude score or superior worker tier.

atoms.exact_source_text: Visible conditions that make residence possible for one named Guest.
atoms.normalized_claim: Terms of Hospitality is defined as visible conditions that make residence possible for one named Guest.

atoms.exact_source_text: Price list, trust meter, or random recruitment threshold.
atoms.normalized_claim: Terms of Hospitality is not a price list, trust meter, or random recruitment threshold.

atoms.normalized_claim: A recruited Guest receives a persistent Citizen Record and remains named in every relevant Register.

atoms.exact_source_text: Relationships, injuries, absence, memory, departure, and death matter at the same moral scale as Core Citizens.
